title: Horrible Experience - No credit card daily transactions limit change option
body:
Can’t believe there is no option to change the credit card daily spend limit.
I always set a minimum limit of 1,000 AED on my credit card so that in case my card is compromised there shouldn’t be a fraud transaction of more than 1,000 AED. I amend the limit whenever I want to make a transaction of more than 1,000 and then change it back to 1,000. But now I’m restricted to AED 1,000 as there is no option to change that limit.
I called the call center they can’t amend it over the phone, I can’t do it on the new desktop version and I can’t amend it on the app as well.
Seriously ? Now I’m regretting why did I upgrade.

title: completely non-usable UX
body:
the app UX is awful, one of worst banking app experience ever:

1) there is no way i can submit a support request, i have to go through a forest of ‘support items’ and their submenus to pick the ‘right’ item and in the end i’m getting an error - this product is not supported for you. 
Support request this is a place where the customer writes about his problem to your support center, the one implemented is not usable and doesn’t work. Also i found a ‘messaging’ functionality but guess what - there is no way to send a message, it says - unable to send

2) in transfer and pay menu i have a notice saying ‘keep your address up to date with smooth transfer’ showing 2 links which are not clickable

3) there is no option to transfer money from current account to the prepaid card, only between accounts

4) there is no option to cancel sms transaction notifications and have in-app notifications instead - you can try to disable sms, but it doesn’t work. in-app transaction notifications do not work either 

5) i couldn’t find a way to change a pin for the card in the app. 

6) the app doesn’t t provide mobile-oriented design for many items. for example fees and charges loads from the web, which is expected to be ‘mobile friendly’, but it’s not. this is not the only example.

7) why does a banking app has nick name option, is it facebook or instagram? what’s the idea behind? 

8) purse transactions are showed with 0 value even though they were not

it’s 2022, not 2010, you can’t make such a misery banking app for the one of the largest banks in UAE

title: Garbage - ENBD regressing backwards
body:
While competitors are moving forward, ENBD is regressing backwards.
